test_title: PYST 10: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the following number and symbol series and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) > 5 * \ + 9 & 6 # 6 4 $ & / @ # $ & 8 3 < (Right)

How many such symbols are there that are immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by another symbol?
solution:
Given: (Left) > 5 * \ + 9 & 6 # 6 4 $ & / @ # $ & 8 3 So, Needed pattern is: Number - Symbol - Symbol.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aee0bdef710fdd6e620e910c22d7027df3dd022b7bb73361be5998c31ec45525.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/490c9ece061e8045bc9ad50a75ce26ad98117744db3bf43e35b6bcd37dbde493.png] 

There are **2** Symbols which are preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a number.

Hence, the correct answer is* 'Option 2'.*
